context.timesheets: Click any day to add a block, or use Autofill month. Overlapping blocks are refused and totals update as you go.
context.leave: Vacation waits for HR. Sick leave is booked at once and HR only acknowledges it, which is exactly how the product treats them.
context.toil: Overtime can become free time. Approve the overtime as HR and the balance appears here.
context.tasks: Comment on a task and watch a colleague reply live. Filter by status or search by title.
context.calendar: Tasks, time off and holidays together. In the product, a private link puts this in your own calendar app.
context.approvals: Timesheets, overtime, leave and sick reports all land in one queue. Reject a single day with a note and only that day comes back.
context.people: Search and filter your company, then invite someone. Accounts are invite-only.
context.export: The monthly form builds itself from the timesheets. In the product this is a real .xlsx, with your own template if you like.
context.roles: Built-in roles stay fixed. Create a custom role from a copy, then tick what it may do.
context.invoices: Draft, send for review, issue, then record part of a payment. The tiles at the top follow along.
context.absences: A company sets up its own absence types. Switch to HR and admin to see the catalogue and decide requests.
context.clients: Client records with default terms and document language. New clients appear on new invoices straight away.
context.expenses: A plain record of what was spent, with the paperwork attached. There is no approval step.
context.templates: Recolour the built-in template and watch the preview, or look at your own layout and Word file.
context.departments: Move someone between departments and their history stays. Teams have leaders who run them.
context.schedules: Company defaults apply to everyone, and a dated version changes one person from a chosen day.
context.activeMonth: Choose which months accept timesheet entries. The current month always stays open.
context.settings: Two-step verification, themes and language. Everything here is a sample, so no real code or account is involved.

timesheet.title: Track time, not complexity
timesheet.lede: Most days take one click. Your work schedule fills in the blocks and the schedule check tells you what is still missing.

steps.title: Pick a day
steps.text: The calendar shows what is logged, what is missing and what is a holiday.

steps.title: Add a block, or autofill
steps.text: Enter a start and end time, or fill a day or a whole month from your schedule.

steps.title: Send it for approval
steps.text: Submit is only available when every day is complete, so HR gets clean months.

leave.title: Time off without the back-and-forth
leave.lede: Vacation needs a yes. Sickness doesn't. Navitecs Flow treats them differently, because they are.

requested.title: Requested
requested.text: A worker picks dates and sees how many days it will use. Weekends and holidays don't count. HR approves, and the days appear on the calendar.

reported.title: Reported
reported.text: Sick leave is booked at once. HR and chosen colleagues are told, and the worker can extend it or end it early.

document.title: Documented
document.text: Photograph the doctor's certificate with a phone. It is encrypted before storage, reminders go out before the deadline, and every read is logged.

leave.toilTitle: Overtime that turns into free time
leave.toilText: Where company policy allows, workers choose per day whether overtime is paid or banked. HR approves it, and the balance is always worked out from the real days behind it.

invoices.title: Invoices that know where they stand
invoices.lede: Draft, review, issue, get paid. Numbering, partial payments and overdue marking are handled for you.

security.title: Built for sensitive data
security.lede: Timesheets and medical certificates deserve care. Here is what Navitecs Flow does, in plain terms.

items.title: Two-step verification
items.text: Authenticator app sign-in with recovery codes. A company can require it for admins or for everyone.

items.title: Encrypted documents
items.text: Absence documents and expense attachments are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they are stored.

items.title: Logged document access
items.text: Only the owner and approved staff can open an absence document, and every read is recorded.

items.title: Short-lived sessions
items.text: Access tokens last 15 minutes. Deactivating someone or signing out everywhere takes effect within about 30 seconds.

items.title: A permission for everything
items.text: Access is decided by a permission matrix and denied by default.

items.title: Account lockout
items.text: Five failed sign-in attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.

items.q: Can I try it before talking to anyone?
items.a: Yes. The interactive demo runs in your browser with a sample company and needs no sign-up.

items.q: How is the price worked out?
items.a: You pay per active employee per month. Choose monthly or yearly billing.
There is nothing to install. Navitecs Flow is designed to work in your phone's browser, including taking a photo of a certificate or receipt with the camera.
The whole product is available in English and Bosnian, and each person chooses their own.

items.q: Can it send invoices to my clients?
items.a: You download invoices as PDF or Word and send them yourself. Payments are recorded by hand, and overdue invoices are marked automatically.

items.q: Does it work with Outlook or Google Calendar?
items.a: Yes, one way. Each person gets a private calendar link that Outlook, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar can subscribe to.

items.q: Who can see a sick note?
items.a: Only the worker and staff allowed to approve leave. Files are encrypted, and each read is logged.

items.q: Can we use our own timesheet form?
items.a: Yes. Upload your own Excel file and map it cell by cell, or use the built-in template.

featuresPage.title: Everything in Navitecs Flow
featuresPage.lede: Every module below exists in the product today, and each one has its own guided presentation in the demo.

timesheets.title: Timesheets
timesheets.text: A month calendar with a day panel and timeline. Work, breaks, compensation, field work, standby and other work time, checked against each person's schedule.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.text: Draft, submit, approve or reject. Reviewers can flag single days with a note, and months can be unlocked when needed.

overtime.title: Overtime
overtime.text: Worked out from the schedule and only counted once HR approves the day, with a queue for bulk approval.

activeMonth.title: Open months
activeMonth.text: Control which months workers can edit. Each new month opens when it is needed.

export.title: Timesheet export
export.text: A monthly Excel file with one sheet per employee, from the built-in template or your own mapped .xlsx.

vacation.title: Vacation
vacation.text: Balances, leave blocks with windows and minimum days, a calendar preview, and a queue for bookings that no longer fit a new policy.

absences.title: Absence requests
absences.text: Your own catalogue of absence types. Request ranges of days, propose make-up time, and let HR approve with or without compensation.

sick.title: Sick reports and documents
sick.text: Booked at once, extended or ended early. Certificates are compressed on the phone, encrypted and logged.

toil.title: Time off in lieu
toil.text: Workers choose paid or banked overtime where allowed, see a ledger, and spend it as days off.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.text: Priorities, due dates, tags, comments, links and an activity timeline, for people or whole teams, with live updates.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: One month view of tasks, time, vacation, absences and holidays, plus a private feed for your calendar app.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: An in-app bell with live pop-ups and links straight to the right screen.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.text: Line items with discount and tax, numbering, multi-person review, partial payments, comments and an activity feed.

clients.title: Clients
clients.text: Full client records with logos, default terms and document language.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.text: Suppliers, tax, and scanned or photographed attachments.

templates.title: Invoice templates
templates.text: A built-in designer, your own letterhead layout, or your own Word file with mapped fields.

people.title: People
people.text: Invites, roles, per-person drill-down, and a workforce summary.

departments.title: Departments and teams
departments.text: Membership history for departments, and teams with leaders who can run them.

schedules.title: Work schedules
schedules.text: Company defaults with dated overrides for each person, plus overtime policy.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.text: A role matrix across modules, with custom roles cloned from a base role.

security.title: Account security
security.text: Two-step verification with recovery codes, a company-wide requirement, and sign out everywhere.

appearance.title: Themes and languages
appearance.text: Six themes plus a custom one, English and Bosnian, and personal time zones.
